title: Pablo Exclusive Grape Ice Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Grape Ice Nicotine Pouches offer a rich and sweet Grape flavour with a cool Menthol edge, making for a satisfying and flavourful nicotine experience. These slim, tobacco-free pouches deliver a steady 30mg per pouch dose, providing strong and consistent satisfaction for experienced users. Their discreet format makes them ideal for moments when smoking or vaping isn’t possible. The soft pouch design sits comfortably under the lip, gradually releasing nicotine over time without smoke, vapour or odour. Grape Ice delivers a nostalgic flavour profile with a refreshing twist, designed for those who enjoy a bold fruit taste combined with cooling sensation. Each can includes 20 pouches. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
